bullets.id: Data AS kemarin campur aduk: PCE inti Agustus hanya +0,2% m/m (3,0% y/y, konsensus 3,3%), tapi PDB Q2 direvisi naik ke 2,2% dan ADP September +90 ribu (konsensus 70 ribu). Emas sempat melonjak ke $4.213 lalu memudar ke kisaran $4.150–4.165.
bullets.en: Yesterday's US data was mixed: August core PCE rose only 0.2% m/m (3.0% y/y vs 3.3% consensus), but Q2 GDP was revised up to 2.2% and September ADP added 90K (70K expected). Gold spiked to $4,213, then faded into the $4,150–4,165 range.

bullets.id: Peluang kenaikan suku bunga Fed Oktober turun ke ~38% dari 51%, tapi yield 10 tahun AS di 5,22% (tertinggi sejak Juli 2007) dan minyak yang tinggi tetap menekan. Emas turun lebih dari 5% dalam sebulan dan masih ~26% di bawah rekor Januari.
bullets.en: Odds of an October Fed hike fell to about 38% from 51%, but the US 10-year yield at 5.22% (highest since July 2007) and elevated oil keep the pressure on. Gold is down more than 5% over the past month and still sits about 26% below its January record.

bullets.id: Level kunci: support $4.100 lalu $4.000 (low 25 Juni $4.009); resistance $4.300. Penentu berikutnya: ISM Manufaktur dan klaim pengangguran hari ini, lalu Non-Farm Payrolls Jumat. Tembus di bawah $4.000 menandai lower low yang mengancam tren besar.
bullets.en: Key levels: support at $4,100 then $4,000 (June 25 low $4,009); resistance at $4,300. Next deciders: ISM Manufacturing and jobless claims today, then Friday's non-farm payrolls. A break below $4,000 would mark a lower low that threatens the larger trend.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp14.000 ke Rp2.581.000/gram, buyback Rp2.391.000 (spread Rp190.000). Galeri24 dijual Rp2.527.000 dan UBS Rp2.552.000. Bantal struktural: bank sentral beli rekor 289 ton di Q2 dan ETF emas bertambah 50 ton sepanjang September.
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp14,000 to Rp2,581,000/gram with buyback at Rp2,391,000 (Rp190,000 spread). Galeri24 sells at Rp2,527,000 and UBS at Rp2,552,000. Structural cushion: central banks bought a record 289t in Q2 and gold ETFs added 50t through September.
